title: PAM Implementation Engineer – Delinea
description:

DelineaPAMSecret ServerConnectorsScriptingREST\-APIIntegrationCertification

Client Introduction Our client is a globally recognized professional services and consulting organization with a strong presence across technology consulting, cybersecurity, risk advisory, digital transformation, and business services. The organization works with leading enterprises worldwide to help them strengthen technology infrastructure, improve operational resilience, manage cybersecurity risks, and implement secure digital solutions. This opportunity is with the client's Cybersecurity / Identity \& Access Management practice, supporting enterprise\-scale Privileged Access Management (PAM) implementations and security transformation initiatives.

Job Overview We are looking for an experienced PAM Implementation Engineer with strong hands\-on expertise in Delinea Secret Server and/or Delinea Privilege Manager to join an enterprise cybersecurity team. The role involves implementing and administering PAM solutions, integrating Delinea with enterprise applications and security platforms, developing custom connectors, automating PAM operations, and supporting privileged account lifecycle management. The ideal candidate will have 2\+ years of hands\-on Delinea implementation experience, strong scripting and REST API knowledge, and experience integrating PAM platforms with enterprise technologies such as Active Directory, SSO/MFA, ServiceNow, SailPoint/Saviynt, SIEM and DevOps platforms. Candidates holding relevant Delinea or CyberArk certifications will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities Implement, configure, administer, and support Delinea Secret Server and Privilege Manager solutions. Design and configure privileged access policies, access controls, approval workflows, and certification processes. Perform privileged account discovery, onboarding, classification, password management, rotation, and lifecycle administration. Configure and manage Distributed Engines, Scanners, Connection Manager, session management, monitoring, and recording. Develop and maintain custom password connectors, application integrations, scanners, reports, and automation components. Integrate Delinea PAM solutions with enterprise platforms including: Active Directory / LDAP SSO, SAML, OIDC and MFA solutions ServiceNow SailPoint / Saviynt SIEM platforms DevOps and CI/CD tools Enterprise applications and infrastructure Develop automation using Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, REST APIs, SDKs, and other supported technologies. Configure password and SSH key rotation for Windows, Unix/Linux, databases, applications, and other privileged accounts. Implement secure session management, privileged session monitoring, and session recording. Support HA/DR architecture, security hardening, upgrades, patching, and platform maintenance. Troubleshoot PAM implementation and integration issues across infrastructure, applications, identity, and security environments. Develop operational reports and dashboards to support security operations, governance, audit, and compliance requirements. Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, application, DevOps, IAM, SOC, and cybersecurity teams to drive PAM adoption. Ensure PAM implementations follow enterprise security standards, access governance requirements, and industry best practices. Participate in solution design, technical documentation, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support.

Mandatory Technical Skills Delinea PAM Hands\-on Delinea PAM implementation experience. Strong experience with Delinea Secret Server and/or Delinea Privilege Manager. Experience with PAM deployment, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting. Experience with privileged account onboarding and lifecycle management. Knowledge of Connection Manager, Distributed Engines, and Scanners. Experience with session monitoring and recording. Custom Development \& Integration Experience developing custom password connectors and application integrations. Strong knowledge of REST API integration. Experience with PAM automation using: Python PowerShell Shell scripting Experience working with SDKs and automation frameworks. Identity \& Enterprise Integration

Hands\-on integration exposure with one or more of:

Active Directory LDAP SAML OIDC MFA SSO ServiceNow SailPoint Saviynt SIEM DevOps / CI\-CD platforms Infrastructure \& Security Windows administration. Unix/Linux administration. Password and SSH key rotation. TLS, PKI, and certificate management. PAM security hardening. HA/DR concepts. Enterprise security and privileged access management best practices.

Preferred Skills Experience with Delinea Secret Server Cloud / On\-Premises environments. Experience implementing Delinea Privilege Manager. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience integrating PAM with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of enterprise IAM and IGA platforms. Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise PAM deployments. Experience with PAM migration, upgrades, and platform modernization. Strong understanding of security governance, audit, and compliance requirements. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications Candidates with any of the following certifications will be preferred: Delinea Certified Engineer – Secret Server Certified Engineer – Privilege Manager OR CyberArk CyberArk Sentry CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer – PAM (CDE\-PAM) CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer – Privilege Cloud (CDE\-CPC)

Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should: Have 2\+ years of hands\-on Delinea implementation experience – Mandatory. Have strong practical experience implementing and integrating PAM solutions. Be capable of independently handling PAM configuration, troubleshooting, integrations, and automation. Have experience developing custom connectors. Be proficient in at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Shell. Have strong knowledge of REST APIs. Understand enterprise identity, infrastructure, and cybersecurity environments. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Be comfortable working with cross\-functional technical and security teams. Be available to join immediately or within 15 days, preferably.

Pay: Up to ₹1,600,000\.00 per year

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
**Position:** Executive Assistant to Founder \& CEO  
**Location:** Kochi  
**Reporting To:** Founder \& CEO

Job Purpose

We are looking for a highly organized, intelligent, and execution\-oriented professional to work closely with the Founder \& CEO.

The role will be responsible for converting the CEO’s decisions and instructions into clear actions, assigning responsibilities, following up with teams, tracking progress, and ensuring timely completion.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend important meetings and discussions with the CEO and record key decisions and action points.
* Convert CEO instructions into clear tasks with owners, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Maintain and regularly update a centralized **CEO Action Tracker**.
* Follow up with BU Heads, Regional Heads, Department Heads, Factory Heads, and other responsible team members.
* Monitor progress and follow up before deadlines.
* Identify potential delays, bottlenecks, and deviations in advance.
* Escalate matters requiring CEO intervention.
* Ensure all assigned actions are followed through to complete closure.
* Prepare daily/periodic updates for the CEO covering:
* Completed actions
* Actions due
* Overdue items
* Major bottlenecks and deviations
* Decisions required from the CEO
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities involving Sales, Projects, Design, Factory, Purchase, HR, Finance, IT, Marketing, Expansion, and other functions.
* Track the implementation of new systems, SOPs, ERP processes, and management decisions.
* Collect and consolidate reports and information required by the CEO.
* Support management reviews and important meetings.
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive business, financial, employee, and management information.
* Travel to branches and factories when required for critical coordination and progress verification.

Candidate Profile

* **Experience:** 5–10 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in CEO/Founder’s Office, Business Operations, Project Management, Program Management, Management Consulting, Strategy \& Operations, or a strong Executive Assistant role with operational responsibilities.
* Experience in multi\-location organizations, manufacturing, interiors, construction, retail, or project\-based businesses will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of business processes and organizational structures.
* Excellent knowledge of **Excel/Google Sheets**.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, dashboards, task\-management, and AI/productivity tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel when required.

Key Skills \& Personal Qualities

The candidate should be:

* Extremely strong in follow\-up and execution.
* Highly organized and systematic.
* Quick to understand instructions.
* Able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Assertive and confident while following up with senior managers.
* Respectful and professional in communication.
* Deadline\-oriented and responsible.
* Analytical and comfortable with numbers.
* Able to differentiate between urgent and important matters.
* Capable of identifying problems before they become delays.
* Calm under pressure and changing priorities.
* Highly trustworthy and confidential.
* Energetic and willing to take ownership.
* Comfortable working directly with a fast\-moving entrepreneur/CEO.

Key Evaluation Areas

* Execution ability
* Ownership
* Follow\-up discipline
* Problem\-solving and intelligence
* Ability to work with senior management
* Ability to manage multiple priorities

**The candidate should:**

* Organize all instructions systematically.
* Categorize and prioritize tasks based on urgency and importance.
* Identify the responsible person/function for each task.
* Define clear deadlines and intermediate follow\-up dates.
* Identify dependencies between tasks.
* Identify matters that require direct CEO involvement or decision\-making.
* Explain how each task will be tracked until complete closure.
* Highlight potential delays, risks, and bottlenecks.
* Prepare a short **CEO Update** highlighting only the critical matters requiring the CEO’s attention or decision.

Pay: ₹75,000\.00 \- ₹95,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
